definitions.gloss: inside story; behind-the-scenes account; insider information
definitions.explanation: A story or account revealing what really happened behind the scenes, especially within an organization, company, or political group. Often involves information not known to the general public.

examples.japanese: ⟦{芸能界|げいのうかい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内幕話|ないまくばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I heard an inside story about the entertainment industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内幕話|ないまくばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暴露|ばくろ}した→暴露する：18209_bakurosuru⟧。
examples.english: A former employee revealed inside stories about the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}られざる→知る：00458_shiru⟧{内幕話|ないまくばなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{書|か}かれていて→書く：00477_kaku⟧、⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になった。
examples.english: This book contains many unknown inside stories about politicians, and it became a hot topic as soon as it was released.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{内幕|ないまく}→内幕：20221_naimaku⟧ (the inside story, what goes on behind the curtain) and ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (story, account). ⟦{内幕|ないまく}→内幕：20221_naimaku⟧ literally means "inner curtain" — from theater, where the audience cannot see what happens behind the curtain.

Often carries a slightly sensational or gossipy nuance, as the information revealed is typically meant to be confidential.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内幕話|ないまくばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暴露|ばくろ}する→暴露する：18209_bakurosuru⟧: to reveal an inside story
- {内幕話|ないまくばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to hear an inside story
- {内幕話|ないまくばなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漏|も}れる→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧: inside information leaks out
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}き→驚き：02562_odoroki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内幕話|ないまくばなし}: a surprising inside story

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裏話|うらばなし}→裏話：14031_urabanashi⟧: behind-the-scenes story — similar meaning, slightly more casual
- {暴露話|ばくろばなし}: exposé, tell-all story — emphasizes the act of revealing secrets
- ⟦{内情|ないじょう}→内情：25305_naijou⟧: inside circumstances — the internal situation itself, not necessarily told as a story
